resources.name: Quantum chemistry package (PySCF, Psi4, or equivalent) capable of HF, B3LYP, and linear-response magnetizability/polarizability calculations

access.notes: Open-source alternatives acceptable. The paper used DALTON; similar results can be obtained with PySCF or Psi4.

resources.name: Uncontracted (13s10p5d2f/11s7p4d) basis set or a comparable triple-zeta quality basis for anapole/mixed polarizability

access.notes: Basis set exchange; use an uncontracted basis for N, B, C, H suitable for magnetizability calculations.

resources.name: Initial molecular coordinates for N2H4, B2H4, C2H6

access.notes: Can be constructed from standard bond lengths and angles (knowledge of chemistry) or obtained from PubChem. Geometry optimization will refine them.
